# Post-mortem: Payment API Outage INC-2024-0142

**Distribution**: Internal — Engineering + Management
**Redaction**: customer IDs hashed, no credentials or IPs included

## Mode & Depth
Draft + Standard (SEV-2 with customer impact forces Standard).

## Summary
On 2024-03-15, payment-api experienced a 15.2% error rate for 47 min.

## Timeline (UTC)
14:18 [TRIGGER] Config deploy rolled out (GitHub PR #4521)
14:23 [DETECTION] Error rate spike to 15.2% (Grafana: payment-slo)
14:26 [DETECTION] PagerDuty alert p99 > 500ms (PD #4821)
14:28 [RESPONSE] On-call acknowledged the page (PagerDuty #4821)
14:38 [ESCALATION] Database team paged (PagerDuty #4821)
14:45 [MITIGATION] Config rolled back (ArgoCD audit log)
14:48 [RECOVERY] Error rate back to baseline (Grafana: payment-slo)
15:10 [RECOVERY] All queued transactions processed (Kibana saved-search)

## Root Cause Analysis
Technique: 5-Why (linear chain, single failed control). Depth 5.
1. Why did payment fail? Redis client could not connect.
2. Why? Connection string was empty at runtime.
3. Why? Config format change nested the key one level deeper.
4. Why accepted? No config schema validation in the deploy pipeline.
5. Why no gate? Pipeline capabilities are never re-reviewed as config grows.

**Root Cause**: no process for re-reviewing deploy-pipeline validation gates as
the configuration surface grows.

## Contributing Factors
| Factor | Impact | Evidence |
|--------|--------|----------|
| No automated rollback | +7 min recovery | ArgoCD has no error-rate trigger |
| Outdated Redis runbook | +4 min diagnosis | Runbook last updated 2023-09 |

## Impact Assessment
| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Duration | 47 minutes (14:23 - 15:10 UTC) |
| Affected users | ~12,000 of ~80,000 active |
| Error rate | 15.2% (34,521 failed requests) |
| Revenue impact | UNKNOWN — no transaction-value tracking |
| SLO budget consumed | 108% of March budget |

## What Went Well
- Alert fired 3 min after first error, inside the 5-min detection SLO.
- Correct escalation to the database team 12 min after detection.

## Action Items
| ID | Category | Description | Owner | Deadline | Ticket | Status |
|----|----------|-------------|-------|----------|--------|--------|
| AI-1 | Prevent | Add config JSON-schema validation to CI | @platform | 2024-04-01 | JIRA-4521 | Open |
| AI-2 | Detect | Alert on Redis connection failures | @sre | 2024-03-22 | JIRA-4522 | Open |
| AI-3 | Mitigate | Auto-rollback on error-rate spike | @platform | 2024-04-15 | JIRA-4523 | Open |

## Lessons Learned
Validation gates decay relative to the surface they guard. Related incidents:
INC-2024-0098, INC-2024-0112 — both config-shaped failures through this pipeline.

## Uncovered Risks
- Revenue impact not quantified — no transaction-value tracking exists.
- Downstream cascade into order-service not traced.
- Whether other services share the unvalidated config path is unverified.
